what: PREREG_02 competition 2 tune: combinations R00..R20 on inner pseudo-questions, 5-fold OOF

definitions.formula: p = softmax(e^a (n/12)^gamma (m + w m_op + b)), b = B beta (fixed 10x9 orthonormal basis, sum b = 0)
definitions.opening: m_op = mean over the question's games with an opening score of the opening log_softmax (0 if none)
definitions.objective: sum_q w_q NLL_q, w_q = 1/(L * questions of the level), + 0.01 ||b||^2; L-BFGS-B bounds {'a': (-4.0, 4.0), 'gamma': (-1.0, 2.0), 'w': (0.0, 4.0)}, starts a in (0.0, 1.0), maxiter 500
definitions.oof: fold f: fit on fit questions (rounds 0-49) of players not in fold f, predict eval questions (rounds 1000-1199) of players in fold f
definitions.metric: official score with rule B; rank_balanced = mean over levels of the per-level mean (main metric); question_mean = plain mean
definitions.bootstrap: players resampled within each level, 1000 times, numpy default_rng(0); same draws for every combination

p02e9.definition: inner per-game accuracy of epoch 9 = mean(argmax of the original-orientation logits in inner_p02e9_d4.npz == label) x 100 (the number tune uses) decides; history.csv val_acc (the notebook's monitoring) is recorded only, and history_same_side flags a disagreement about the threshold
p02e9.reason: dumps present and inner accuracy >= threshold
